systems.system: scanning and indexing of civil registration records
systems.tiers: listed as a need of RITA, not as work under way

note: A statistics plan (December 2021): for RITA it records past support (CRVS assessment and ICT equipment) and lists needs, among them decentralisation of death registration and better storage of civil registration records through scanning and indexing; its targets concern vital statistics data integration and portals. Nothing states how or where a birth or death is recorded.
